thread:
marie: Heads up — release gate failing on staging. cache-validate step in pipeline #3218 errored during artifact checksum verification. Canaries were auto-paused. :(

deploy-bot: deploybot paused promotion for commit abc123def due to `cache-validate` failure on runner staging-05. Error: artifact checksum mismatch (expected sha256: `a1b2...`, got `c3d4...`). Auto-retries exhausted (3/3).

jordan: ugh. any idea if it's an upstream upload issue or local runner corruption? logs?

marie: quick tail from the job:
```
Checking artifact: s3://redwood-builds/release/abc123/artifacts.tar.gz
sha256sum artifacts.tar.gz
expected: a1b2c3d4e5f6...
actual:   c3d4e5f6a1b2...
exit status 2
```
marie: looks like object present but checksum flipped. Could be upload race or cache layer returning stale chunk.

ash: if this is a single runner return, re-run may fix. But this is blocking the change window — we have ~45m. I'd prefer we avoid manual promote unless we confirm integrity.

lee: +1. Two quick options: 1) Reupload artifact from CI artifacts bucket (last-good stored at `releases/v1.4.7/`) and trigger a retry; 2) Pin release to v1.4.7 and open a rollback/incident if we can't validate.

jordan: I'll try a reupload + checksum calc. Running small script to pull the build output from the ephemeral buildkite cache and push into the canonical bucket with verified sha256.

marie: please paste the command once you run it so we can audit. Also notify @ash for release note change.

jordan: running:
```
aws s3 cp buildkite/cache/3218/artifacts.tar.gz s3://redwood-builds/release/abc123/artifacts.tar.gz --acl private
sha256sum artifacts.tar.gz > artifacts.sha256
aws s3 cp artifacts.sha256 s3://redwood-builds/release/abc123/artifacts.sha256
```

jordan: triggered reupload and re-calculation. kicking a manual retry on the pipeline now (`deploybot retry 3218 --by user:jordan --reason \"reupload checksum\"`).

deploy-bot: Manual retry requested by jordan for pipeline 3218. Queued on runner staging-07.

ash: thanks. if retry succeeds, we still should run an additional quick smoke on canary instances (db migrations + smoke auth) before promoting.

lee: agreed. also update release notes to mark that we handled an artifact integrity issue; callout for QA to keep an eye on timeouts.

marie: decision for now — no manual promote yet. Jordan to confirm retry status; if retry fails again within change window we'll pin back to v1.4.7 and schedule a short rollback. If retry succeeds we'll run the extra smoke tests and then decide.

ash: noted. filing a tiny internal note under the release ticket with the pin/rollback plan. :memo:

jordan: retry job started (staging-07). watching logs.

marie: thanks — please post final job exit code here. If we see the same mismatch across runners, escalate to infra for S3/network investigation.

lee: adding a watch on latency metrics and S3 5xx for the last hour. will ping infra if anomalous.

deploy-bot: Pipeline 3218 retry completed with exit code 0. Cache-validate step PASS. Canaries remain paused pending smoke tests.

marie: great — jordan can you kick the smoke run? small checklist: migrations 1, auth smoke, a simple generation call against the model endpoint.

jordan: smoke started. I'll post quick results.

(40m later)
jordan: smoke all green. migrations ok, auth OK, sample gen within SLO.

marie: we will proceed with canary promotion in 10m and monitor. If anything flakey appears, we roll back to v1.4.7. Adding a note to release notes: \"Hotfix: artifact integrity re-upload and validation; smoke tests passed; canary promoted.\"

ash: 👍 thanks everyone.

lee: monitoring — no abnormal S3 errors. closing watch unless we see spikes.

marie: closing thread — mark release as continued.
